name: Kilmerve Shur
source:
If you don't want doors slammed in your pretty face, fix that unattractive personality first. Shur disregards such garbage advice. He'll rock the world with his acting, not act as a people pleaser. And as a famous actor once told him, why fix what's not broken...?
